comparison.objective: Load an IV set into a pump in a required fitment-first sequence; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Seat two small tubing fitments while preventing stretch, lift, and twist versus long-part support, spring-prong engagement, telescoping, and screw driving.
comparison.success_condition: Requires fitment-first ordering, clamp depth, no stretch/twist, clearance, and a two-second hold; candidate requires matched rack units, complete spring engagement, correct screw holes, and released support.
comparison.reason: Sequenced insertion is shared only at a generic level; the tested physical constraints differ.
